model.repository_identity: arcinstitute/ST-Tahoe (inferred: the local cache records the revision and file digests but not the repository id; anonymous listing of the repository returned HTTP 401 on 2026-09-13)
model.digest_basis: local SHA-256 values equal the LFS sha256 entries of the cached repository tree at the recorded revision
model.input_coordinate_identity_basis: the identity of the space this checkpoint reads, verified gene by gene against log1p of X in the c39 asset; a dataset registered with the same embedding key and feature count but a different gene selection is refused against this list rather than assumed to match

corrected_official_repository.historical_registry_attribution: ST-Tahoe was an older inferred attribution, corrected by official recovery on 2026-10-01

input.preprocessing: official processed coordinates; 1969 match log1p(X); full raw normalization and 31 coordinate identities unresolved
input.controls: disjoint same-plate basal/reference halves; 32 basal draws with replacement, fixed seed 731

perturbations.encoding: 1138 one-hot complete drug-dose labels including control

conditions.endpoint: predicted native X_hvg mean and intervention minus sampled basal mean

inference_window.support: official CLI uses variable homogeneous windows, padded=False, including short remainder windows
inference_window.not_claimed: equivalence to 256-cell distributional evaluation or complete CLI postprocessing (clip to 14)

registered_receipts.split: 5-fold drug-level cross-fitting over 379 drugs with disjoint vehicle wells; exploratory re-analysis of inspected data
registered_receipts.acceptance_criterion: In the primary scheme, the mean paired squared-error difference state_plus_dose_mean minus dose_matched_mean is below zero and its upper 95% drug-bootstrap bound is below zero.
registered_receipts.metric: mean paired squared-error difference, state_plus_dose_mean minus dose_matched_mean
caveats: The declared comparator (dose-matched development mean) is itself worse than predicting no change under disjoint vehicles, so passing this criterion is uninformative.
Post hoc, scaled State minus no change: -0.000205 [-0.000230, -0.000181]; State plus dose mean minus shrunken dose mean: -0.000203 [-0.000227, -0.000180].
NCI-H596 is probably a training context of this checkpoint; the drug holdout is the evaluator's, not the model's.

training_overlap.related_split_semantics: Official zeroshot/generalization.toml does not list NCI-H596 as cell-type holdout; different filename from config prevents exact training exposure proof
training_overlap.c39_overlap: unknown, likely training context; previously exposed locally
